name: Controllers
author: marshmallow-mia
summary: Set up your controllers for Echo VR through EchoXR: the angle and position of your hands, stick and trigger deadzones, vibration and a Menu button combination. Presets to pick from, your own presets, and preset files to pass on.

fields.label: Hands from

choices.label: Meta
choices.tooltip: Where a Rift puts your hands, the same on every headset and runtime

choices.label: Revive
choices.tooltip: The runtime's pointer, as Revive and EchoXR before 0.6 did: angle and position vary with the runtime

fields.help: Meta is where Echo VR expects your hands.

fields.label: Tilt up
fields.help: Your hands point higher (or, below 0, lower) than your controllers.

fields.label: Turn inwards
fields.help: Both hands turn towards each other (below 0: apart).

fields.label: Roll outwards
fields.help: Both hands roll their tops outwards (below 0: inwards).

fields.label: Stick deadzone
fields.help: How far a stick moves before it counts. Raise it if you drift.

fields.label: Trigger deadzone
fields.help: How far a trigger is pulled before it counts.

fields.label: Grip deadzone
fields.help: How far a grip is squeezed before it counts.

fields.label: Menu button

choices.label: X + Y
choices.tooltip: Left X and Y together open Echo VR's menu

fields.help: X + Y: for runtimes that keep the Menu button for themselves.

fields.label: Face forwards at start
fields.help: Echo VR's forwards is where you look when it starts.

fields.label: Log the hands
fields.help: Once a second, in EchoXR's runtime.log: where your hands are and how fast they move.

presets.name: Default
presets.help: Where a Rift puts your hands.

presets.name: Revive
presets.help: Hands from the runtime's pointer, as before EchoXR 0.6.

blocks.text: Controllers needs launcher 0.11.16 or newer: Settings, Update now.
These settings apply when Echo VR plays through EchoXR: SteamVR, Virtual Desktop, WiVRn or Monado. Changes apply right away, also while you play.
Export… saves your settings as a file; Import… adds one someone gave you.
Needs launcher 0.11.16 or newer (Settings, Update now) and EchoXR 0.6.
